title: The Necessary
description: Add Mods to Optimize Minecraft and improve many things
body:
# The Necessary

## What does this modpack do ?

This modpack adds 50+ mods (20+ for **1.12.2**) to **optimize Minecraft** and **improve the HUD, recipe viewing, tooltips, and more**, making Minecraft smoother, more convenient, and easier to manage.

## Features

**Core features**

<details>
<summary>Optimization</summary>

**Render**: Sodium (Fabric + Neoforge), Embeddium (Forge)

**Mob AI**: Lithium (Fabric + Neoforge), Radium (Forge)

**Chunk Loading**: C2ME (Fabric + Neoforge), C2MEF (Forge)

**Culling**: Entity Culling, More Culling

**Bug Fixes**: ModernFix (Fabric), Packet Fixer

**Reduce Memory Usage**: FerriteCore

**Block Entity Rendering (Fabric)**: BBE

**Light Optimization**: ScalableLux, Starlight

**Worldgen Optimization**: FastNoise

**Optimize immediate mode rendering**: ImmediatelyFast

**Reduce resource usage whie game in background**: Dynamic FPS

**Fast language switching**: Language Reload

**Optimize Minecraft server**: ServerCore

**Misc Optimizations and Bug fixes**: ModernFix/ModernFix-mVus, BadOptimizations, PacketFixer

![Forge Optimization](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Gvp9bbxY/images/ab2c31d55bfda5aef5b9653d682bfd6ec52fb56c.png)

</details>

<details>
<summary>HUD improvement</summary>

**Hunger and Saturation viewing**: AppleSkin

**View armor durability**: uku's Armor HUD

![Uku](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ae9b4bb6906fcde55ceee7be8a7e664dfe6247e_0.webp)

**Effect timing**: Status Effect Bar (Fabric), Effect Timer Plus (Neoforge + Forge)

![Status Effect Bars](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/x02cBj9Y/images/b078783e15bacfd25185abbce01cea107e2106bd.png)

**Show Hotbar, Hunger Bar, etc. while riding mobs**: Better Mount HUD (Fabric), Leave My Bar Alone (Neoforge + Forge)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Player appearance improvement</summary>

**OptiFine Cape (Fabric)**: Capes

**3D Skin**: 3D Skin Layers

</details>

<details>
<summary>Tooltip improvement</summary>

**Shulker Box item preview**: Shulker Box Tooltip

![Shulker box tooltip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ea418388ba5e9c533fcea16851c09cab4ea52f0_0.webp)

**Item durability viewing**: Durability Tooltip

</details>

<details>
<summary>Inventory Sorting</summary>

* **Inventory Profiles Next**: Inventory sorting

* **Crafting Tweaks**: Arrange items more easily while crafting

* **Mouse Tweaks (Fabric + Neoforge)**: Arrange items with mouse clicks

</details>

<details>
<summary>Other features</summary>

**Zoom**: Zoomify (Fabric), Just Zoom (Neoforge), Zume (Forge)

![Zoomify](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/w7ThoJFB/images/58587830dc7f5af65dca92af567d0e7906c54fda.webp)

**Dynamic Lights**: LambDynamicLights

**Shader**: Iris Shaders (Fabric + Neoforge), Oculus (Forge)

**Fullbright**: Gamma Utils (Fabric), Fullbright UB + Clear Lava, Water Resourcepacks (Neoforge + Forge)

**LAN server (Fabric + Neoforge)**: e4mc

**Recipe manager**: JEI

![JEI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/u6dRKJwZ/images/156edbd1e04f86d64edc4f41a6d00e849bc7984b.png)

**Better visibility when on fire**: Low on Fire (Resourcepack)

**Sodium/Embeddium Support**: Translations for Sodium (Resourcepack), Sodium Extra (Fabric + Neoforge) / Embeddium Extra (Forge), Reese's Sodium Options (Fabric + Neoforge)

**View items while on a boat**: Boat Item View

**Mod management/config**: Mod Menu (Fabric), Forge Config Screens (Forge)

**Download Resourcepacks in-game without using a web browser (Fabric + Forge)**: Resourcify

![RESOURCIFY](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RLzHAoZe/images/d1a2bf740a322e78d8df960c9e4272707df3793a.png)

**Quit to the main screen without waiting**: fastquit

**quick pack** - 26.1+: Decrease Datapack-loading time

</details>

## Bugs and Issues

### Report bugs and issues

Please report issues here: https://github.com/break08/The-Necessary/issues

Many versions may have bugs in one or more mods included in this modpack, and I do not have enough time to test every version thoroughly. Please report any issues so I can remove the problematic mod and replace it if possible.

### Solve the issues by yourself

If there are bugs/issues and you can solve them yourself, choose some solutions:

1. Remove the mods causing the issue

2. Install its required dependencies mod (if required)

Note: **Fabric loader will always open a window to report to you the issue when Minecraft crash (except when you install a mod like Crash Assistant), read them to know how to solve the problem.If you can't read crash reports from logs/mod loaders/console, copy them and send to ChatGPT or other AI, they may be able to help you**

**Finally, open an issue in project site on GitHub.**

## Some Notices:

### Overall

* **The mods listed above are not all the mods in this modpack; they are only the core mods**

* **Some versions may lack some of the features above because they are too old, outdated, or too new to receive updates immediately**

* **Some features above may exist in a version, but the mods providing them may be different from the ones listed here**

* **The features above are for the latest or near-latest versions. Therefore, backported versions of the modpack may not include all of them**

### On Tlauncher

* Tlauncher Capes conflicts with some mods in this pack: **Entity Culling, Capes, ...**

### Requirements

* **Fabric Loader (With Fabric)**: at least **0.18.4**
